propositions: The fourth ADR 0056 named extraction (build_agent_kwargs) plus the post-call telemetry blocks are still inline in PydanticAIRunner.run() and must be moved into a new leaf module.
Three inline blocks are relocated into new module agent_call.py as plain functions (build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, record_call_spend) with explicit parameters and no carrier object.
The _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site stays in run() because it is a runner module global patched via monkeypatch; web_caps is passed in as a parameter to avoid defeating patches.
log_call_success and record_call_spend must remain separate functions on opposite sides of finalize_outcome to preserve the ok-line-on-finalization-failure behavior.
A new structural seam test pins the extracted function contracts and covers edge/failure paths without editing any existing test.
The change is a pure relocation adding no behavior; the existing suite must pass unedited against the recorded baseline pass count.
